name: Steve
summary: Steve is a referral from Brendan who acts as a middleman for friends with Instagram account problems. In late July 2026 he sent screenshots of two IG accounts — @ericthgt (permanently disabled, 'We disabled your account,' appeal already submitted May 6 2026) and @chadshawnn (Account Status showing removed content/messaging issues, restricted features, and monetization flags) — and asked about shadowban removal and account unbans, stressing there was zero nudity or sexual content. He was quoted $3,200 for a permanent unban with a 0–48 hr turnaround; the removed-content ban on the already-appealed account was assessed as most likely not fixable. As of 2026-08-03 the deal is stalled — Steve's friend never responded and Steve thinks he doesn't have the funds, so this is a warm-but-cold lead worth a light check-in later.
key_facts: Introduced himself 2026-07-29 as 'Steve, Brendan's friend' — referred by Brendan
Acts as middleman, not the account owner; relaying for a friend
IG account @ericthgt — permanently disabled, appeal submitted May 6 2026, no further review allowed
IG account @chadshawnn — Account Status flags on removed content/messaging, features restricted, monetization restricted
Quoted $3,200 for permanent ban removal, 0–48 hr TAT
Told him the removed-content ban was likely unfixable since an appeal was already filed
Steve insisted both accounts had zero nudity/sexual content
Deal not closed as of 2026-08-03 — friend unresponsive, likely lacks funds
Earlier contact on 2026-07-11 ('this is all he has') suggests a prior back-and-forth on the same or another account
services_discussed: Instagram permanent ban removal / account unban
Instagram account status and restriction fixes
